prompt:
Create a production source sheet containing EXACTLY TWO SEPARATE HORIZONTAL LANDSCAPE CUTOUTS of ONE original fairy-tale woodland family, on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. These are TWO independent depth assets for a 2D side-view game, not one scene and not a seamless panorama. Reference1 is approved limestone/moss paint planes and upper-left soft light. Reference2 is the game's existing distant panorama and supplies only atmospheric perspective and simplified tree brushwork; do not reproduce its mountains, sky, waterfalls, buildings or stone bridge. Reference3 is the newly produced repair workshop and supplies material/brush continuity only; do not include buildings or windmills.

TOP CUTOUT: a very low broad distant ridge of soft small cool grey-green woodland silhouettes, a few unequal tree groups with large natural sky gaps, tied to ONE complete small undulating natural slope/base. This is far distance: quiet low-frequency broad painterly shapes, very low internal contrast, pale cool shadow, no distinct bright trunks or yellow flowers. About6times wider than tall. Complete left/right ends slope down naturally; no hard horizontal side cuts. Complete natural slope bottom and all tree roots stay within this cutout.

BOTTOM CUTOUT: a more legible but still receding middle-far woodland stand on its OWN complete low natural ridge: two or three unequal clusters of original broadleaf trees with one or two narrow fir accents, irregular sweeping silhouettes and substantial transparent sky gaps in the center and upper right. About3.2times wider than tall. Slightly darker desaturated grey/sage green than the TOP layer, restrained yellow-green accents and cool lavender-grey trunk/root shadows, still quieter than the game's actors/real standing surfaces. A few visible tree trunks connect continuously into THEIR OWN low sloping soil/limestone root ridge, with the entire root and foot contour intact. Never leave floating detached crowns or trunks without roots. Gentle upper-left daylight and visible soft gouache strokes. No giant flowers, hard shiny leaves or tall vertical screen-filling forest wall.

The two cutouts must NOT touch or overlap. Provide a clear full-width transparent horizontal gap at least80pixels between them, with generous exterior transparent margins; use a generous wide source sheet with top and bottom rows as needed. This intentional transparent inter-row gap is required; do not introduce an accidental vertical transparent seam through either solid ridge. There must be NO terrain connecting the two cutouts and NO shared foundation. Both are independent whole shapes with roots attached to their own complete low hill. Natural alpha boundaries, not rectangular color bars. Background is all alpha0, including all sky holes, not painted sky colors. Do not draw labels, guides, dividers, checkerboards, frame, shadows on a floor, horizon strip, fog panel, colored rectangle or opaque background. No mountains, waterfall, sky, ruins, bridge, characters, UI, symbols, gates or objects. No cliffs resembling playable ledges, flat bright grass platforms, stairs or repeated horizontal treads. No scenery painting behind or between them.

RUNTIME PURPOSE (do not depict): top far tree ridge will move slowly with its OWN slope as one source region, depth factor0.28, approximately world1300wide×200..240high. Bottom middle-far tree stand and its own root slope will be a separate source region, factor0.12, approximately950wide×280..310high. The existing world panorama remains much farther away. Actual route occupies the clear space in front, so the new tree/ridge edges must not masquerade as playable surfaces. The whole top row and whole bottom row will later be independently sampled from the original PNG WITHOUT pixel repainting; ensure their silhouettes and true transparent margins are clean and genuinely separated. This is a production asset sheet, not a concept illustration.

style continuity only; original-spec failures retained

space_contract.vertical_guard: Natural leave frame for +-700 and high_reward about-1300; no bottom opaque extension, viewport corner following or vertical repeat

source_measurements_required: actual independent connected body regions and transparent row gap
per-row alpha1/2/128/250 bbox and source ground_line
both whole slope/root endpoints and safe AtlasTexture regions/filter_clip
actual object ratio, source colour/contrast difference, skyline negative space
no full-scene opaque sky/hills panel or unintentional transparency through root
admission: No whole-image two-layer claim; two real Sprite/Atlas regions and relative-motion actual movie needed; if tool merges cutouts preserve failure and do not fabricate layers
